message: No update bot delays new versions of Go dependencies: the repository configures neither Dependabot nor Renovate, and Go has no release-age delay of its own, so nothing holds back the versions the dependencies in tools/go.mod are updated to
fix: Update these dependencies with Dependabot (an updates entry with package-ecosystem: gomod in .github/dependabot.yml) or Renovate (its gomod manager), then run depcurfew init and depcurfew apply, which give the bot a cooldown; depcurfew delays Go dependencies only through these bots
